purpose: Frozen canonical Hub identities and immutable commits for the full-distribution prompted WiC/CoLA/PAWS finalist lane. This is a separate lane from the balanced 1,943-case common screen; none of these rows may be added to that screen.

dataPrepEnvironment.note: The finalist lane must be prepared in the same locked binary-only data environment as the common screen, so task/answer regeneration is byte-identical across preparations.

resolution.policy: Each requested ref is resolved exactly once through HfApi.dataset_info(repo_id, revision=ref).sha to a full 40-hex commit, and the commit is proved to live in that repository before any load. All load_dataset calls use the resolved commit, never the requested ref.

PAWS.canonicalIdentity: google-research-datasets/paws is the canonical Hub ID; the bare name `paws` answers HTTP 307 to it and has no independent commit history, so it is never loaded.

commonScreenBoundary.rule: The full-distribution lane is prepared and receipted separately. prepare-kaggle-benchmark.py does not build this lane, and these rows must never be merged into the 1,943-case common screen.

protocolOverridesPolicy: A reviewed non-canonical repository may only be used when an entry names the source, the exact non-canonical dataset ID, and a reviewedIn reference (issue or PR). An override never allows a retired alias, and never allows a non-full or wrong-repository commit.
